items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: I had worked with her with the Buddy Rich band... I went in and worked with her at Michael’s Pub... went on the road with her... recorded with her

ctx.x: Now this is a — I did a record with her out in California.

For some reason she came in to the picture because it’s a Gene Krupa legend. They were trying to — I call it “humping the grave.” They just keep trying to hump the grave you know. So now like here is Anita O’Day playing at Michael’s Pub in New York. And I had worked with her with the Buddy Rich band at the Blue Note. And they brought some drummer in from Boston, who, I don’t know whatever happened, I don’t even know who he was or what he was, but he lasted about one night and she was pretty rough to deal with.…
